13319754.t: Globasa is the product of an elaborate thought experiment.

13319763.t: Globasa's design is primarily the work of a linguist, translator and expert in adult language acquisition and teaching.

13319772.t: We are working to increase the number of resources available for learning and using Globasa.

13319790.t: In Globasa, only a handful of words, such as matre and patre, indicate gender. Otherwise, words denoting people are gender-neutral.

13320543.t: Globasa does not distinguish between singular and plural nouns.

13320545.t: Globasa has neither definite nor indefinite articles (the words a and the in English).

13320547.t: Globasa has no verb conjugation, meaning that verbs don't change according to the subject (or doer) of the sentence.

13320554.t: The typical word order in Globasa is subject-verb-object, the same as in English.

13320619.t: Word order in Globasa is rather strict.

13320701.t: You can learn Globasa in one year.
